props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the step that should be active when initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control the state of the steps.

props.name: dir
props.description:
The reading direction of the stepper when applicable.
If omitted, inherits globally from `ConfigProvider` or assumes LTR (left-to-right) reading mode.

props.name: linear
props.description: Whether or not the steps must be completed in order.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the step to activate. Can be bound as `v-model`.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation the steps are laid out.
Mainly so arrow navigation is done accordingly (left & right vs. up & down).

slots.name: default
slots.type: { modelValue: number | undefined; totalSteps: number; isNextDisabled: boolean; isPrevDisabled: boolean; isFirstStep: boolean; isLastStep: boolean; goToStep: (step: number) => void; nextStep: () => void; prevStep: () => void; hasNext: () => boolean; hasPrev: () => boolean; }
